datePolicy: Original source access dates remain November 6, 2026 Korea local date (some receipts November 5 UTC); fuel data November 5. Author local arithmetic, weekday, literal and registry checks are not external refreshes. Director separately reports successful Office Holidays re-fetch on November 6; its separate audit owns that evidence. Other sources, including timeanddate, retain original observations only; no fresh official-calendar confirmation claimed here. No publication date invented.
uncertainties: Tamra dated K3 requires 26+ and licence held over one year; LOTTE general 21 minimum does not transfer Tamra pricing. All-in under-26 eligible-car pricing unresolved; reference rates exclude unpriced waiver.

CDW expires after one accident. UCDW exclusions and ambiguous own-vehicle deductible remain material; liability category deductibles are not a total loss cap, and trip reserve is not accident-liability insurance.

No October 2027 three-adult hotel quote or availability. Breeze Bay SGD55 was a two-adult November teaser not tied to triple room; repeat blocked. Playce JPY5428 is November two-guest average, not a selected-date quote; two rooms must be compared.
Holiday dates retained from secondary calendars, not official-calendar certification; later temporary holiday announcements possible. Booking pressure is inference, not measured premium.

Return timing corrected only in new pages: arrive rental area 17:00, finish return 17:45, allow 30–45 minutes, terminal target 18:30 for assumed 20:30 flight; original supplier booking boundary remains 18:00. Transfers/traffic remain planning estimates.

Current fares, menu prices, museum/summit opening and astronomical sunrise are dated observations, not 2027 guarantees. Wind/storms can close summit or make trail unsafe; no trip-date forecast or taxi availability established.

Recomputed per-person car allocation 444100 before reserve, 544100 with reserve, headroom 55900 under 600000; bus 456100. Flights, Seoul airport access, travel insurance and accident/fine exposure excluded.
editingContract: Local English and Simplified Chinese Markdown plus schema v2 JSON only; source-grounded self-checks, whole-body and corresponding table-cell literal parity. No source-run/shared inventory/build/renderer edits, no new Review or public attachment promises.
